shortDescription: Create or Delete OSPF configuration on AOS-CX

options.name: area_id
options.description: OSPF Area Identifier, in X.X.X.X form, or as a number in [0, 4294967295].

options.name: area_type
options.description: Alphanumeric option defining how the external routing and summary LSAs for this area will be handled.

options.name: ipsec_ah
options.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both ipsec_ah and ipsec_esp are configured.

options.name: ipsec_esp
options.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. Specifies SPI, encryption/authentication type, and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec ESP if both ipsec_ah and ipsec_esp are configured.

options.name: ospf_id
options.description: The OSPFv3 Router the Area will belong to once created

options.name: other_config
options.description: Extra configuration parameters for the area

options.name: state
options.description: Create or update or delete the OSPF Area.

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF the OSPFv3 Area will belong to once created. If the OSPFv3 Area is created and the user wants to change its VRF, the user must first delete the OSPFv3 Area, and then recreate it in the desired VRF.
